rows.question: My battery stops charging at 80 percent, is it broken?
rows.answer: Here's what our support guides say: A battery that stops charging at 80% is usually not a fault: Battery Conservation Mode is enabled. [KB-001#1] The battery icon shows "plugged in, not charging", the charge level stays the same while connected, or a full charge takes more than 4 hours. [KB-001#1] This clears the embedded controller and fixes most "not charging" cases after a firmware update. [KB-001#3]

rows.question: Can I charge my Aurora Book 14 with a 20W phone charger?
rows.answer: Here's what our support guides say: Confirm the charger is the original 65W USB-C adapter (Aurora Book 14, Edge X1) or 100W adapter (Book Pro 16). [KB-001#2] Phone chargers under 45W charge very slowly or not at all. [KB-001#2] The battery icon shows "plugged in, not charging", the charge level stays the same while connected, or a full charge takes more than 4 hours. [KB-001#1]

rows.question: How do I do a battery reset when it won't charge?
rows.answer: Here's what our support guides say: The battery icon shows "plugged in, not charging", the charge level stays the same while connected, or a full charge takes more than 4 hours. [KB-001#1] A battery that stops charging at 80% is usually not a fault: Battery Conservation Mode is enabled. [KB-001#1] Shut the laptop down, unplug the charger, then press and hold the power button for 15 seconds. [KB-001#3]

rows.question: Is battery replacement covered after 18 months?
rows.answer: Here's what our support guides say: If health is below 60% of design capacity, or the battery health status reads "Replace", the battery is eligible for replacement under warranty during the first 12 months. [KB-001#4] After 12 months the battery is a consumable part and replacement is chargeable unless you has Premium Care. [KB-001#4] Run the Battery Health test in Aurora Vantage. [KB-001#4]

rows.question: Where do I find my serial number?
rows.answer: Here's what our support guides say: The serial number is on the label under the device, in Aurora Vantage > Device, or by running `wmic bios get serialnumber` in Command Prompt. [KB-002#1] Aurora serial numbers are 10 characters, starting with two letters followed by eight digits or letters, for example PF3A9K2L01. [KB-002#1]

rows.question: What does Premier Support include?
rows.answer: Here's what our support guides say: Available with Premium Care and Premier Support. [KB-012#2] Premier Support targets next business day onsite service when the case is logged before 3 pm local time. [KB-012#2]

rows.question: My warranty expired last week, can I still extend it?
rows.answer: Here's what our support guides say: If the warranty has expired, you can still get a paid repair quote or buy a warranty extension within 30 days of expiry without an inspection. [KB-002#4] Physical damage, liquid damage, cosmetic wear, and software issues caused by third-party applications are not covered by Base Warranty. [KB-002#3] After 30 days, an extension requires a remote diagnostic first. [KB-002#4]

rows.question: How many accidental damage claims can a consumer make per year?
rows.answer: Here's what our support guides say: Business you with Premier Support get two claims per 12-month period. [KB-003#2] Consumers get one ADP claim per 12-month period. [KB-003#2] ADP covers drops, spills, electrical surges, and cracked screens from accidental use. [KB-003#1]

rows.question: I spilled coffee on the keyboard, what should I do?
rows.answer: Here's what our support guides say: If the keyboard works in BIOS, the problem is a Windows driver; reinstall it from Aurora Vantage. [KB-010#1]

rows.question: Does accidental damage protection cover theft?
rows.answer: Here's what our support guides say: It does not cover theft, loss, intentional damage, or cosmetic damage that does not affect function. [KB-003#1] ADP covers drops, spills, electrical surges, and cracked screens from accidental use. [KB-003#1] The serial number, a short description of how the damage happened, the date it happened, and photos of the damage. [KB-003#3]

rows.question: Blue screen INACCESSIBLE_BOOT_DEVICE after BIOS update
rows.answer: Here's what our support guides say: The device restarts with a blue screen showing a stop code such as DRIVER_IRQL_NOT_LESS_OR_EQUAL or INACCESSIBLE_BOOT_DEVICE, often within a day of an update. [KB-004#1] INACCESSIBLE_BOOT_DEVICE after a BIOS update: enter BIOS (press F2 at startup) and confirm the storage mode is set to "NVMe/AHCI", not RAID. [KB-004#2] If Windows still boots, open Aurora Vantage > Updates and roll back the most recent driver, or uninstall the latest Windows update in Settings > Windows Update > Update history. [KB-004#2]

rows.question: How do I uninstall a Windows update if the laptop keeps crashing with a blue screen?
rows.answer: Here's what our support guides say: If Windows still boots, open Aurora Vantage > Updates and roll back the most recent driver, or uninstall the latest Windows update in Settings > Windows Update > Update history. [KB-004#2] The device restarts with a blue screen showing a stop code such as DRIVER_IRQL_NOT_LESS_OR_EQUAL or INACCESSIBLE_BOOT_DEVICE, often within a day of an update. [KB-004#1] If Windows does not boot, interrupt startup three times to open Windows Recovery Environment, then choose Troubleshoot > Advanced options > Uninstall Updates. [KB-004#2]

rows.question: My laptop won't turn on at all, nothing happens
rows.answer: Here's what our support guides say: If nothing responds after a hard reset with a known-good charger, the device needs a hardware repair. [KB-005#4] Flicker that happens only in some apps is usually a graphics driver issue: update or roll back the graphics driver. [KB-009#1]

rows.question: Where is the emergency reset pinhole on the Edge X1?
rows.answer: Here's what our support guides say: On the Aurora Edge X1, there is also an emergency reset pinhole on the bottom panel: press it for 10 seconds with a paperclip. [KB-005#2] Unplug the charger, press and hold the power button for 30 seconds, plug the charger back in, wait 5 minutes, and press the power button once. [KB-005#2]

rows.question: Wi-Fi keeps disconnecting every few minutes
rows.answer: Here's what our support guides say: Most Wi-Fi drops come from power-saving settings on the wireless adapter, an outdated Wi-Fi driver, or router band steering between 2.4 GHz and 5 GHz. [KB-006#1] If the Wi-Fi option is missing completely from Windows, or Device Manager shows no wireless adapter after a BIOS reset, the wireless card may have failed. [KB-006#3] Update the Wi-Fi driver through Aurora Vantage > Updates. [KB-006#2]

rows.question: Will I need my BitLocker recovery key after a BIOS update?
rows.answer: Here's what our support guides say: If you is asked for a BitLocker recovery key, they can find it at their Microsoft account under Devices > Manage recovery keys, or from their company IT department for business devices. [KB-007#4] Suspend BitLocker first (Control Panel > BitLocker > Suspend protection) or you will be asked for the BitLocker recovery key after the update. [KB-007#1] Aurora support cannot retrieve or bypass BitLocker keys. [KB-007#4]

rows.question: Can support retrieve my BitLocker recovery key for me?
rows.answer: Here's what our support guides say: If you is asked for a BitLocker recovery key, they can find it at their Microsoft account under Devices > Manage recovery keys, or from their company IT department for business devices. [KB-007#4] Aurora support cannot retrieve or bypass BitLocker keys. [KB-007#4] Suspend BitLocker first (Control Panel > BitLocker > Suspend protection) or you will be asked for the BitLocker recovery key after the update. [KB-007#1]

rows.question: The fan is really loud during video calls, is that normal?
rows.answer: Here's what our support guides say: The fans speed up during video calls, gaming, or compiling, and the bottom of the laptop can reach 45°C under load. [KB-008#1] If the laptop shuts down from heat during light use, or the fan makes a grinding or clicking noise, the fan or thermal paste needs service under warranty. [KB-008#3] Update the BIOS and embedded controller firmware (KB-007), which contain fan curve fixes. [KB-008#2]

rows.question: How many dead pixels before the screen is replaced?
rows.answer: Here's what our support guides say: A display is eligible for replacement under warranty if it has 3 or more bright pixels, 5 or more dark pixels, or any bright pixel in the central area of the screen. [KB-009#2] Fewer defects than this are within the panel specification and are not replaced. [KB-009#2] Flicker or lines that also appear in the BIOS screen (press F2 at startup) point to a hardware fault in the panel or display cable. [KB-009#1]

rows.question: My trackpad is raised and won't click
rows.answer: Here's what our support guides say: A trackpad that is raised, stiff, or does not click can be a sign of a swollen battery underneath. [KB-010#2] Check that the trackpad is not disabled with the F6 trackpad toggle key. [KB-010#1]

rows.question: How long do I have to return a laptop bought from the online store?
rows.answer: Here's what our support guides say: Customers can return a device within 30 days of delivery for a full refund, as long as it is in its original condition with all accessories. [KB-011#1] Devices bought from retailers must be returned to that retailer. [KB-011#1]

rows.question: Is there a restocking fee for a custom configured laptop?
rows.answer: Here's what our support guides say: Opened devices with a custom configuration (CTO) carry a 15% restocking fee. [KB-011#2] There is no restocking fee for unopened devices. [KB-011#2] Devices with physical damage cannot be returned. [KB-011#2]

rows.question: How long does a depot repair take?
rows.answer: Here's what our support guides say: Target turnaround is 5 to 7 business days from when the depot receives the device. [KB-012#1] Base Warranty: 12 months parts and labour, depot (mail-in) repair. [KB-002#2] Premium Care: 24 or 36 months, onsite or depot repair, 24/7 phone support, battery covered for the full term. [KB-002#2]

rows.question: Can Premier Support customers keep their old hard drive after repair?
rows.answer: Here's what our support guides say: Premier Support you can choose the "Keep Your Drive" option: the technician replaces a failed drive and you keeps the old one, for data security. [KB-013#2] Repairs can involve replacing or reimaging the storage drive. [KB-013#1] Ask you to back up their files before sending a device for repair. [KB-013#1]

rows.question: How many 4K monitors does the Dock U3 support?
rows.answer: Here's what our support guides say: The Aurora Dock U3 supports up to two 4K monitors at 60 Hz; a third monitor will not display. [KB-014#1] The Aurora Dock U3 supplies 90W. [KB-014#2] Update the dock firmware and the laptop's graphics and Thunderbolt drivers through Aurora Vantage. [KB-014#1]

rows.question: What is the first response SLA for a P2 case?
rows.answer: Here's what our support guides say: First response: P1 within 1 hour, P2 within 4 hours, P3 within 8 hours, P4 within 24 hours. [KB-015#2] Resolution: P1 within 24 hours, P2 within 48 hours, P3 within 5 days, P4 within 7 days. [KB-015#2] P2 High: a single device unusable with you data at risk, or a Premier Support you with a device down. [KB-015#1]

rows.question: How do I factory reset before selling my laptop?
rows.answer: Here's what our support guides say: Go to Settings > System > Recovery > Reset this PC. [KB-016#1] "Remove everything" erases the drive and is the right choice before selling or returning a device. [KB-016#1] Interrupt startup three times to open Windows Recovery Environment, then choose Troubleshoot > Reset this PC. [KB-016#2]

rows.question: My battery is swollen and the case is lifting
rows.answer:
Here's what our support guides say: If the case is lifting, the trackpad is pushed up, or there is a hissing sound or burning smell, stop using the device and unplug it immediately. [KB-001#5] The battery icon shows "plugged in, not charging", the charge level stays the same while connected, or a full charge takes more than 4 hours. [KB-001#1] A battery that stops charging at 80% is usually not a fault: Battery Conservation Mode is enabled. [KB-001#1]

For your safety, please stop using the device and unplug it now. I've flagged this as urgent and a specialist will contact you.

rows.question: There is smoke coming from the charging port
rows.answer:
Here's what our support guides say: Check the charging LED next to the USB-C port: solid white means charging, blinking amber means a charging fault. [KB-001#2] Open Aurora Vantage > Power and turn off Battery Conservation Mode if you wants charging to 100%. [KB-001#2] The battery icon shows "plugged in, not charging", the charge level stays the same while connected, or a full charge takes more than 4 hours. [KB-001#1]

For your safety, please stop using the device and unplug it now. I've flagged this as urgent and a specialist will contact you.
